title: I Thought I Understood Credit Cards Until I Talked to This Guy
channel: Chris Koerner on The Koerner Office Podcast
promo_conflict: Brandon Elliott promotes Credit Council Elite and its Capital Bootcamp, shares the bootcamp signup page and business Instagram, and describes funding and credit-repair outcomes that may encourage people to buy his program.

stated_problem.quote: And it's just that knowledge of knowing that that's even a possibility.

idea.name: 0% business credit funding education
idea.one_liner: Teaches business owners and investors how to build credit profiles and sequence bank applications to access business funding; sells access to a virtual bootcamp and member program.
idea.customer: Business owners and real-estate investors seeking capital.
idea.offer: Funding education, credit-profile guidance, and application sequencing through Credit Council Elite and Capital Bootcamp.
idea.revenue_model: Virtual bootcamp tickets are sold; member-program fees are implied but prices are not stated.

idea.name: Authorized-user tradeline marketplace
idea.one_liner: An online intermediary connects people seeking a higher credit score with cardholders leasing aged authorized-user slots, earning a markup between the buyer's payment and seller payout.
idea.customer: Consumers seeking to improve their credit profile, plus cardholders willing to lease authorized-user slots.
idea.offer: Temporary access as an authorized user on an established credit-card account.
idea.revenue_model: Marketplace markup; the guest says sellers received $125 to $200 while intermediaries resold access for about $2,000.
